skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze basic concepts and principles of macroeconomics, including national income, inflation, unemployment, financial systems, and monetary systems.
Apply basic economic models to analyze and evaluate the impact of macroeconomic policies on short-term and long-term economic stability.
Develop skills in logical reasoning, problem identification, and problem-solving in macroeconomic contexts.
Enhance abilities in independent research, teamwork, and creative thinking to address practical economic issues.
Foster self-study and continuous learning to deepen understanding of macroeconomic issues.
Understand and apply concepts of savings, investment, financial markets, present and future value, and risk management.
Analyze the role of monetary policy in economic stability and growth.
Understand and evaluate the impact of fiscal policies on economic stability and growth.
Analyze factors influencing economic growth and development.
Understand and analyze the causes and effects of inflation.
Analyze types and causes of unemployment and policies to address it.
Apply basic economic models to understand short-term and long-term economic dynamics.
Interpret economic indicators such as GDP, CPI, and unemployment rates.
Evaluate the effectiveness of economic policies in stabilizing the economy.
Understand the functioning of economic systems and their components.
